title: Payments: suffix, Stripe Connect, own keys, back to Velexis
caption: PF-60 to PF-62. M5 parts need FEATURE_OWN_STRIPE (and Stripe test values).

steps.title: Card statement suffix
steps.body: Type a suffix such as `ACME TRAVEL`, watch the preview, **Save**.
steps.expect: Preview `VELEXIS* ACME TRAVEL` (≤22); `ACME*TRAVEL`, accents, `&`, `.` or `-` refused in the browser; `payment_provider_connections.statement_descriptor_suffix` updated.

steps.title: Connect with Stripe
steps.body: **Connect with Stripe** (step-up), authorise in Stripe test mode.
steps.expect: Back on payments with `?stripeConnect=connected` (or `pending`); test row `account_mode = 'connect_standard'`, `account_reference = acct_…`.

steps.title: Own Stripe keys
steps.expect: Webhook URL to create in Stripe and the events list; verification status every 2 s until applied or failed.

steps.title: Use Velexis payments
steps.body: On an own-account card: **Use Velexis payments**, confirm, step-up.
steps.expect: `account_mode = 'velexis'`; for live, PAYOUT_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED without a verified payout account.
